items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Olivette Miller, who was Flournoy Miller's daughter, playing the harp as a specialty in the act.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was in the show. And Olivette Miller, who was Flournoy Miller's daughter, playing the harp as a specialty in the act. And if she could play harp, I can. At that time, you know, as a novice. But she learned a little. But I heard great harpists, you know, out of studios. And comparing her with them, you know, was just about where she stood. I'm sorry to say it, but it was her shortcomings, you know, not mine. Ain't my job. (laughs)
And after playing the Lincoln Theatre for a week, they became stranded.
